cue: When two runs produce equivalent substantive coverage and only differ in verification safeguards (e.g., quote appendices, cite-check flags)
lesson: Invest in record-verification guardrails (verbatim-quote appendices, pin-cites, citation flags) rather than broader analysis, because output quality differentiates on citation integrity, not issue discovery
evidence: Both DOM and INV runs identified the same core issues and recovered from extraction failures equally, but only the run with verification safeguards caught misquotes and flagged non-record citations — coverage parity with verification asymmetry
